desc: Buenos Aires Central Station. It was the terminal station of Ferrocarril Buenos Aires al Puerto de la Ensenada (Buenos Aires & Ensenada Port Railway). The station was placed on Av. Paseo de Julio (today Av. Leandro N. Alem) and Bartolomé Mitre. Opened in 1878,
titulo: Estación Central de los Ferro-carriles Unidos (Junior, 1876).jpg
